name: Agent Writing Style
description: Opinionated agent writing style. The plugin injects a prose discipline into the system prompt, so the model writes like a knowledgeable human and not like AI text. It bans em-dashes and semicolons. It removes AI vocabulary (for example delve, tapestry, pivotal). It removes copula avoidance (serves as, stands as) and 'not just X but Y' parallelisms. It also removes superficial -ing tails, sycophancy, signposting, significance inflation, vague attribution, emoji used as formatting, and mechanical boldface. The user can override it per request. This is a prompt-only plugin: its only contribution is the PROMPT.md behavior mandate.
